verses.text: So then, my dear brothers and sisters, whom I love and miss, my joy and crown—stand firm in the Lord this way, dear friends.
I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
Yes, my true partner, please help these women. They worked hard alongside me in the Good News, together with Clement and my other co-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
Celebrate in the Lord always! I'll say it again: celebrate!
Let everyone see your gentleness. The Lord is near.
Don't be anxious about anything. In everything, bring your requests to God through prayer and petition, with thanksgiving.
Then God's peace, which is beyond all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true, honorable, right, pure, lovely, admirable—if anything is excellent or worthy of praise—think about these things.
Put into practice what you learned, received, heard, and saw in me. Then the God of peace will be with you.
I was so glad in the Lord that your concern for me has finally come alive again. You always cared, but you didn't have a chance to show it.
I'm not saying this because I need anything. I've learned to be content in whatever situation I'm in.
I know how to live with little, and I know how to live with plenty. I've learned the secret of facing any circumstance, whether I'm full or hungry, whether I have plenty or need.
I can do all things through Christ, who gives me strength.
Still, you did well to share in my trouble.
You Philippians know that in the early days of the Good News, when I left Macedonia, no church partnered with me in giving and receiving except you.
Even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent help for my needs more than once.
I'm not looking for a gift. I'm looking for the fruit that increases to your account.
I have everything I need and more. I'm well supplied, now that I've received from Epaphroditus what you sent—a sweet-smelling offering, a sacrifice God accepts and enjoys.
My God will meet all your needs from his glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
To our God and Father be glory forever and ever! Amen.
Give my greetings to every one of God's holy people in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters with me send their greetings.
All God's people here send you greetings, especially those who belong to Caesar's household.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
